text_block_list.text:
—What?
You trying to say anything a runt does is pointless?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden burst of fury cuts through the midday cafeteria, shattering
the gentle hum of chatting horsegirls into instantaneous silence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence... followed by a ripple of murmurs.
The center of every horsegirl's bewildered gaze was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —a horsegirl so petite and fragile-looking it took me aback.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa, wait, wait, wait!! You've got it wrong, Taishin—!!
I didn't mean it like that at all...!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket has a point this time, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sufficient nutrition is undeniably essential for physical growth,
but your current intake is excessive. It borders on binge eating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive spread of food covered the table beside them.
If all of that was meant for Narita Taishin alone, it was indeed far too much...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Listen to reason. You have a small appetite to begin with.
Just the other day after a meal, your complexion turned—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I said shut up!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: T-Taishin... But, but I just...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Don't come any closer!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Stop following me around already.
Just leave me alone...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later that night, after witnessing that uneasy scene...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way back from working late,
I happened to stop by the training track—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... haah...!!
choice_data_list: (Someone's out here training on their own this late...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah, gh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running around the track was the same petite horsegirl from earlier today—
Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... ugh, kh—
...Aaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clenching her teeth, Narita Taishin raced around the track,
letting out a cry that sounded as if she were coughing up blood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her run with such painful intensity, all I could feel from her
was a deeply agonizing... impatience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later... the day of the Debutant Race, where horsegirls
showcase their abilities to prospective trainers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having entered their 'twilight surge'—the peak physical phase of a horsegirl's life—
they overflowed with drive to display the fruits of their training. Among them—

text_block_list.name: Competing Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Competing Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I didn't see you there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Among those girls on the verge of their debut, Narita Taishin
looked as though she might be swallowed up by the crowd at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that girl over there is awfully tiny, isn't she?
...Still, doesn't look like there are any standout prospects in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Girls from distinguished lineages or those brimming with raw talent
carry an entirely different aura around them, after all.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Come now, we won't know for sure until we see them run.
Well, they're about to start...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
I'll do it... Today's the day...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, the runners are in the gates—
and they're off!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: HAAH...!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I thought that small girl would hang back, but she's pushing forward!
Is she really trying to muscle into the fight for position...?!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Hmm. But with that build of hers—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, fighting for position is too punishing for her.
The size disadvantage is simply too overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Damm... it...!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oof, she keeps getting shoved around...
There's no way her stamina lasts like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The leaders are rounding the fourth corner!
And making their move now is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin! Narita Taishin with an incredible final spurt!!
She bursts to the front in a flash!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah...!!
Ngh, guh...!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...She burned through far too much energy early on.
Running reckless like that... It's painful to watch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no doubt about the brilliance of the late-stage kick she showed for a moment. But in the end,
Narita Taishin gradually fell back—finishing in 10th place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, after the race—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*... *haah*... Dammit.
...My head... hurts...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Taishin-san, we need to talk... Oh, are you alright?
You still haven't caught your breath...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tch! I'm fine, it's nothing.
...What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Well... it's just as I thought. Taishin-san, I really think...
it's best if you don't stay in the racing world like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the Twinkle Series with that kind of body is reckless.
It could lead to irreversible damage.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Before that happens... give up on this path.
Even for an umamusume, there are other ways to live besides running, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-san! Please, I'm saying this for your own good.
Listen to me properly—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, SHUT UP!!
For my own good? Ha, screw you!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win with these legs. I swear I'll win.
I'll shove it right in your face, just you watch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin spat out those words and sprinted away.
The cornered look on her face was seared into my mind...
